dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk You're going to put a metal coin with a private key to an address on Dogecoin in it on the Moon? Expecting a lot of business from aliens, the Russians or the Chinese with payments done in Dogecoin?

Could this be called moondropping a coin?
@cameron @Gemini Definitely a friendly coin and community! The absence of haughty Dogecoin maximalism is palpable.

@elonmusk @loshan1212 @itsALLrisky Whether or not Dogecoin can become a currency of choice globally crucially depends on governments granting it legal tender status. Otherwise dealing in DOGE will remain an accounting and taxation nightmare. I don't see Dogecoin becoming legal tender anywhere.
@elonmusk @itsALLrisky The world has enough insecure, fast and cheap means of payment already. I wish Dogecoin success anyway. There is no competition in crypto.
